Method of Attack: Malicious archive delivered via LinkedIn lure with job offer at Corsair, containing ZIP file with DOCX/PDF and TXT files, embedding VBS script that downloads and executes payloads; malware attempts to uninstall security products automatically after installation; also includes phishing attacks through Microsoft Teams and compromised Skype accounts sending VBS scripts
Impacted Systems: Users holding social media management positions with access to Facebook business accounts in U.S., U.K., and India; Microsoft Teams users; Skype users
Attack Vector: LinkedIn posts and direct messages with malicious download links; phishing attacks via Microsoft Teams; compromised Skype accounts sending VBS scripts
Indicators of Compromise: ZIP file: Salary and new products.8.4.zip
Files: Job Description of Corsair.docx, Salary and new products.txt, PDF Salary and Products.pdf
Use of curl.exe renamed and autoit3.exe with compiled Autoit3 script
Metadata linking to RedLine stealer distribution
